title: Primus Monthly Engineering Report — 2026-09
key_findings: 79 PRs merged to main in the window. Largest categories: Other 23 (model/backend enablement: Kimi K3, NeMo AutoModel/Wan 2.2, DeepSeek-V4 CP + gfx942, FLUX FP8, gfx1250 multi-GPU), Bug Fix 18, CI/Infra 11, Performance Optimization 9, Refactor 7, Turbo/Dependency Version Update 6, Docs 5.

No backend-gap-tracked pin changed in-window: third_party/Megatron-LM stayed at d3528a21 and third_party/torchtitan stayed at 73a0e697 (v0.2.2 tag) for the whole window. Therefore backend_gap_updated = false; no backend-gap report was regenerated.

Other in-window pin movement (not backend-gap targets): third_party/maxtext advanced a7c6c7e5 -> b47d74bf (PR #1021, quantized MoE fix). maxtext has no backend-gap report set, so it is noted but not regenerated.

Megatron-LM upstream drift: pin d3528a21 (2026-03-06, unchanged) is now 1371 commits behind upstream HEAD 114888079 (2026-09-01). Notable upstream since pin: Megatron-FSDP mixed-precision/async-save, MoE router/FlexDispatcher/NVFP4, Hybrid/Mamba + DeepSeek Sparse Attention, CUDA-graph MTP inference. Recommendation: plan sync.

torchtitan upstream drift: pin 73a0e697 (v0.2.2, 2026-02-20, unchanged) is now 918 commits behind upstream HEAD 496b11d4 (2026-09-01). Notable upstream since tag: Kimi K2, Qwen 3.5, GPT-OSS models, shared models/common abstractions, DeepSeek-V3 mxfp8. Recommendation: plan sync.

Primus-Turbo Q3 quarterly drift (anchor 2026-07-01 00:00 GMT+8): CI pin advanced +107 (3c39ef25 -> 6d5ff979 via #933/#1028/#1048); benchmark pin advanced +35 (3c39ef25 -> a04a233c). AITER moved b5e03ed1 -> 0f3c58e6 (v0.1.14.post1); TRITON 88b227e2 -> 09500db9; UCCL 5afb4117 unchanged. Notable: FlyDSL MXFP8/MXFP4 GEMM and MegaMoE kernels, HipKittens gfx950 attention, gfx1250 build support, DeepEP cheap-fence fix. Recommendation: monitor.

Notable hardening this month: DeepSeek-V4-Flash attention/MoE math fix (#949), Turbo weight-gradient microbatch fix (#1046), KDA hipBLASLt dead-zone padding (#1050), pipeline short-batch warmup clamp (#1032), and SOCKET_IFNAME IP fallback fix (#1063).
